verdict.rationale: Plausible explicitly documents importing historical Google Analytics data ('bring in your historical data') and a CSV import feature ('Import stats: bring in data via CSV'), directly matching the story of bulk-importing historical events from another tool or export. This is corroborated by community mentions of migrating from GA using this feature. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of CSV import fidelity/limits, and documentation detail on supported event/data formats beyond GA.
